source: Judiciary of Kenya Small Claims Court Act (2016) & Court Fees Rules
qualifyingClaimTypes: Unpaid supply or trade invoices for goods delivered
Unpaid casual wages or contractual service fees
Withheld residential or commercial security deposits
Breach of simple written or verbal commercial contracts
Property damage claims arising from negligence or accident under KES 1M
disqualifiedClaimTypes: Claims involving title deed disputes or ownership of land
Employment termination disputes involving union collective agreements
Claims exceeding KES 1,000,000 in principal value
